senses.gloss: to think carefully and deeply about something

translations.ja_JP: 考慮すること。熟考する

definition_translations.zh_TW: 仔細且深入地思考某事
definition_translations.ja_JP: 何かについて慎重かつ深く考える
definition_translations.vi_VN: suy nghĩ kỹ lưỡng và sâu sắc về điều gì đó

senses.gloss: to consider doing something in the future
senses.example: The company is contemplating opening a branch in Singapore.

translations.th_TH: ไตร่ตรอง; พิจารณา

example_translations.zh_TW: 該公司正在考慮在新加坡開設分公司。
example_translations.ja_JP: その会社はシンガポールに支店を開設することを検討しています。

example_translations.vi_VN: Công ty đang cân nhắc mở một chi nhánh tại Singapore.

definition_translations.ja_JP: 将来何かを行うことを検討する
